dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete expert knowledge not usually known by a generic model: exact default Lambda timeout (3 s) vs managed‑template timeout (30 s), the four‑step rotation protocol, precise mapping of log phrases to diagnostic layers, and the exact IAM/KMS permission sets required for each layer. This is specific, actionable expertise beyond a baseline description.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes an AWS‑specific diagnostic mindset with ordered procedures (describe‑secret → get‑function‑configuration → VPC checks → IAM simulation → EventBridge validation). Procedures are concrete and AWS‑centric, only a minor deduction for occasional generic phrasing.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: A detailed NEVER list is provided with concrete reasons (e.g., never raise timeout above 30 s before checking VPC, never invoke the Lambda directly). The list is thorough but includes a few generic warnings (“never guess”) that lack specific AWS context.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Complete frontmatter, clear description, exhaustive when‑to‑use/when‑not‑to‑use, activation triggers, invocation schema, and a minimal valid example. An agent can reliably decide when to invoke the skill.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Top‑level Quick‑Start gives immediate actionable guidance, with deeper sections (Mindset, Philosophy, detailed probes) layered below. Some cognitive load remains due to length, but critical rules are not buried.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are gated behind explicit CONFIRM prompts; all diagnostic probes are read‑only. Calibration matches fragility of rotation operations perfectly.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a coherent, recognizable pattern (Quick start → Mindset → Philosophy → Decision tree → Anti‑patterns → Pre‑flight → Process → Output). Minor deviation in section ordering prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides a working decision tree, concrete CLI commands, and example outputs that an agent can execute end‑to‑end. Minor usability issues: some commands omit explicit --region flags, and the EventBridge Scheduler vs Rule distinction is noted but not integrated into the diagnostic flow, leaving a potential edge case unhandled.
